description: This source file contains utility functions for handling bundled plugins in an OpenClaw project, including reading plugin manifests, determining public surface files, collecting build entries, and listing artifacts and dependencies.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Collects build entries for bundled plugins based on manifest existence, package.json, and top-level surface files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Creates a mapping of plugin entry points to their normalized file paths in POSIX format.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Generates a sorted list of artifact file paths for bundling output, including JSON manifests, package.json, and JavaScript files.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists all runtime dependencies from collected plugins that are marked for staging, including dependencies and optional dependencies.
